t: Spokes generate self-registry entry at closeout and send to hub via signal for hub-registry.json updates
description: Each spoke generates its own registry entry on closeout. Sends to hub via signal pipeline. Hub replaces spoke entry in hub-registry.json.
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai-closeout.md — find where to add registry signal step (after Step 9c). 2. Read hub/hub-registry.json — current per-spoke fields. 3. Read WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json — fields that map to registry entry.
execute: 1. Add Step 9d to wai-closeout.md: generate spoke registry update signal from WAI-State.json fields (wheel_id, spoke_id, path, foundation_name, project_description, current_phase, framework_version, last_session). 2. Write as signal lug to bytype/signal/undelivered/ with target: 'hub'. 3. Hub gardener processes: reads signal, updates matching entry in hub-registry.json. 4. Sync closeout to all targets.
verify: 1. After closeout, bytype/signal/undelivered/ has a registry update signal with all required fields. 2. Gardener can parse and apply the update to hub-registry.json.
acceptance_criteria: Closeout generates spoke registry update signal from WAI-State.json fields
Signal written to bytype/signal/undelivered/ with target hub
Signal contains wheel_id, spoke_id, path, foundation_name, project_description, current_phase, framework_version, last_session
Hub gardener can parse and apply update to hub-registry.json

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Auto-generate spoke registry entries at closeout — keeps hub-registry.json current
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not manual registry management — automatic, driven by closeout
